plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C5: an answer that checks every worker read against the approved list. Scope of a call works only on named lines, at 10 per line, and the worker makes 101 reads, so it cannot be afforded within the plan or the 50 allowance. (2) C10: an answer that checks every sending call's notice in the outbox. Trace of a call is named-line only, at 10 per line, so 100 sends cost 1000. Neither is in the plan. (3) C3: no instrument checks a category against the requester's rule, and the agreement does not fix the rule's values, so the category cannot be shown by any answer. (4) 'sent as released' is true only as of the time it is taken, so at A3 it must be taken after the last sending call is ordered, or the late calls fall outside it. (5) The 50 allowance covers only about 5 named lines of scope or trace checks, so any gap found during the work can be closed for a few customers only.
